Open Mornings for Reception Families
If your child is due to start school in Reception in September 2027, we are delighted to invite prospective families to our school.
Our Open Mornings, consists of a short presentation and a tour of the school followed by a Q & A.
They are a great opportunity for parents to take a look at the school and ask any questions they may have about our provision. We are really proud of our school and look forward to telling you more about it.
All open mornings will be led by the Head Teacher.
Click on your preferred date to book.
